articles.event_key: 乌克兰|指称美国延迟交付拦截导弹并称未获俄袭击预警
articles.title: 泽连斯基指称美国延迟交付拦截导弹，白宫称情报共享政策未变
articles.summary: 泽连斯基指称美国故意延迟交付欧洲国家已付款的拦截导弹。白宫称对乌情报共享没有变化，国务卿鲁比奥否认存在“暂停”，称系乌方预警系统软件问题。泽连斯基顾问对BBC称美方预警不完整、不一致。
articles.new_facts: 泽连斯基指称美国故意延迟交付欧洲国家已付款的拦截导弹；乌方顾问对BBC称美方预警不完整、不一致；白宫称情报共享未变，鲁比奥否认“暂停”，称系软件问题。
articles.limitations: 乌方指控与美方回应均属表态，导弹交付与款项细节未获独立核实；白宫说法来自一名以背景方式发言的官员。

facts.text: 据《卫报》报道，乌克兰总统泽连斯基指称美国故意延迟交付欧洲国家已付款的防空拦截导弹。这一指控由乌方提出，报道未提及美方对导弹交付问题的直接回应。

evidence.quote: Zelenskyy claims US deliberately delaying interceptor missile deliveries to Kyiv

facts.text: 白宫表示，美国与乌克兰的情报共享操作没有变化。国务卿鲁比奥否认存在“暂停”，称“不知道泽连斯基从哪里得到这些信息”，并称几晚前乌方早期预警系统出现软件问题。

evidence.quote: The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing with Ukraine.
Rubio said he could not comment on the incident, adding: "I know a few nights ago there was a software problem involving their early warning system."

facts.text: 泽连斯基的顾问别斯克列斯特诺夫对BBC称，美方提供的预警不完整且不一致，曾出现袭击前一分钟才收到信息的情况，“人们已经死亡”。他还称，美方对“星链”及“星盾”限制未作澄清。

evidence.quote: Serhii "Flash" Beskrestnov told the BBC that lives had been lost because there had not been time to warn citizens about ballistic missile strikes, saying: "It's dangerous... I think it's really very bad... People [have] already died."
However, he said other collaboration with US continues, adding: "Intelligence data keeps flowing, and the issue is solely with the air raid alert component."

bilingual.title_en: Zelensky Alleges US Delayed Delivery of Interceptor Missiles; White House Says Intelligence-Sharing Policy Unchanged

sentences.en: According to The Guardian, Ukrainian President Zelensky alleged that the United States deliberately delayed the delivery of air-defense interceptor missiles that European countries had already paid for.
sentences.zh: 据《卫报》报道，乌克兰总统泽连斯基指称美国故意延迟交付欧洲国家已付款的防空拦截导弹。

sentences.en: The allegation was made by the Ukrainian side, and the report did not mention any direct US response to the missile-delivery issue.
sentences.zh: 这一指控由乌方提出，报道未提及美方对导弹交付问题的直接回应。

sentences.en: The White House said that US intelligence-sharing operations with Ukraine have not changed.
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，美国与乌克兰的情报共享操作没有变化。

sentences.en: Secretary of State Rubio denied that there was a "pause," saying he did not know where Zelensky got this information, and said that a few nights earlier Ukraine's early-warning system had experienced a software problem.
sentences.zh: 国务卿鲁比奥否认存在“暂停”，称“不知道泽连斯基从哪里得到这些信息”，并称几晚前乌方早期预警系统出现软件问题。

sentences.en: Zelensky's adviser Beskrestnov told the BBC that the warnings provided by the US side were incomplete and inconsistent, with information sometimes arriving only one minute before an attack, and that "people have died."
sentences.zh: 泽连斯基的顾问别斯克列斯特诺夫对BBC称，美方提供的预警不完整且不一致，曾出现袭击前一分钟才收到信息的情况，“人们已经死亡”。

sentences.en: He also said that the US side had not clarified its restrictions on Starlink and Starshield.
sentences.zh: 他还称，美方对“星链”及“星盾”限制未作澄清。

articles.event_key: 以色列|警方拘留西岸定居者袭击记者与外交官事件嫌疑人
articles.title: 以色列警方拘留西岸定居者袭击记者与外交官事件10名嫌疑人
articles.summary: 约旦河西岸橄榄收获季发生定居者袭击美国摄影记者及欧洲外交官事件后，以色列警方拘留10名嫌疑人。美国大使欢迎逮捕，以总理办公室质疑相关视频和证词。
articles.new_facts: 以色列警方拘留10名涉嫌袭击美国摄影记者和欧洲外交官的西岸定居者，美国大使欢迎逮捕，以总理办公室质疑视频证据。
articles.limitations: 仅见BBC报道，未直接取得以色列警方声明原文；嫌疑人身份与是否起诉未公布；以总理办公室对事件定性提出质疑。

facts.text: 以色列警方表示，已在约旦河西岸多地拘留10名嫌疑人，涉嫌实施暴力、违反封闭军事区命令和非法建设，并查获潜在证据和车辆。此前，一名美国摄影记者在阿布法拉赫村报道橄榄收获时遭蒙面定居者殴打受重伤，次日比利时、法国、波兰外交官和天主教会代表在附近泰贝遭蒙面定居者袭击。

evidence.quote: Israeli police say they have arrested 10 suspects in the occupied West Bank after attacks by settlers on an American journalist and European diplomats last week.

facts.text: 美国驻以色列大使赫卡比在社交平台X上欢迎逮捕，称这是“非常积极的进展”。以色列总理内塔尼亚胡办公室则质疑相关视频证据和证词，称事件为“所谓”袭击，并称其发生在“协调一致抹黑以色列”的运动中。

evidence.quote: The US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, welcomed the arrests. "A very positive development in finding & punishing those who severely attacked and beat Heidi Levine," he wrote on X.

Despite the international condemnation, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office questioned the video evidence and testimony from the incidents in Abu Falah and Taybeh. It described them as "alleged" attacks and said they came amid what it called a "co-ordinated campaign to smear Israel" and West Bank settlers.

bilingual.title_en: Israeli Police Detain 10 Suspects Over West Bank Settler Attacks on Journalists and Diplomats

sentences.en: Israeli police said they have detained 10 suspects in multiple locations in the West Bank on suspicion of committing violence, violating orders on a closed military zone and illegal construction, and seized potential evidence and vehicles.
sentences.zh: 以色列警方表示，已在约旦河西岸多地拘留10名嫌疑人，涉嫌实施暴力、违反封闭军事区命令和非法建设，并查获潜在证据和车辆。

sentences.en: Previously, an American photojournalist was severely beaten by masked settlers while reporting on the olive harvest in the village of Abu Falah, and the next day Belgian, French and Polish diplomats and a representative of the Catholic Church were attacked by masked settlers in nearby Taybeh.
sentences.zh: 此前，一名美国摄影记者在阿布法拉赫村报道橄榄收获时遭蒙面定居者殴打受重伤，次日比利时、法国、波兰外交官和天主教会代表在附近泰贝遭蒙面定居者袭击。

sentences.en: US Ambassador to Israel Huckabee welcomed the arrests on social platform X, calling them "a very positive development."
sentences.zh: 美国驻以色列大使赫卡比在社交平台X上欢迎逮捕，称这是“非常积极的进展”。

sentences.en: The office of Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu, meanwhile, questioned the video evidence and testimony, describing the incident as a "so-called" attack and saying it occurred within "a coordinated campaign to smear Israel."
sentences.zh: 以色列总理内塔尼亚胡办公室则质疑相关视频证据和证词，称事件为“所谓”袭击，并称其发生在“协调一致抹黑以色列”的运动中。
